items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Board Unanimously Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Director
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA董事會一致通過恢復黃仁勳總裁、CEO與董事職務
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced on November 23 that its board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director effective immediately, after discussions and input from senior U.S. government levels. The board stated it is confident the reinstatement poses no national security risk. Huang said he is honored to return and looks forward to leading the company.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA於11月23日宣布，董事會在討論並收到美國政府高層意見後，一致投票恢復黃仁勳為總裁、CEO與董事，立即生效。董事會表示確信此舉不構成國家安全風險。黃仁勳表示榮幸回歸並期待領導公司。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid reinstatement of NVIDIA's founding CEO removes a major leadership uncertainty for the dominant AI accelerator supplier. Ongoing independent investigations into reported foreign intelligence targeting continue in parallel.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 迅速恢復NVIDIA創辦CEO消除了主導AI加速器供應商的重大領導不確定性。針對報導中外國情報針對的獨立調查仍並行進行。
items_flat.quote: I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我榮幸回歸NVIDIA，並在新工業革命之初領導世界上最具影響力的科技公司之一。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Chief Scientist Publishes Internal Perplexity Numbers, Proposes Shared Development Limits
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI首席科學家公布內部Perplexity數據，提議共同發展限制
items_flat.summary_en: Jakub Pachocki published 'Perplexity and Intelligence' on OpenAI's site, disclosing internal log-perplexity on a held-out codebase dataset: GPT-3.5 ~0.99, GPT-4 ~0.91, recent models below 0.8, and a math-breakthrough model around 0.76. He proposed that frontier labs commit to common limits based on perplexity and other metrics that they will not cross until interpretability and monitoring reach a concrete milestone, such as successors to chain-of-thought monitors.
items_flat.summary_zh: Jakub Pachocki在OpenAI網站發表〈Perplexity and Intelligence〉，首次公開內部log-perplexity數據（固定程式碼資料集）：GPT-3.5約0.99、GPT-4約0.91、近期模型低於0.8、數學突破模型約0.76。他提議前沿實驗室承諾基於perplexity等指標的共同限制，在可解釋性與監控達到具體里程碑前不跨越，例如思維鏈監控的後繼工具。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is rare quantitative transparency from a leading lab on pretraining progress and an explicit call for industry pacing norms. Whether other labs adopt comparable metrics or limits remains open; cross-lab comparison is complicated by differing data mixtures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是領先實驗室罕見的預訓練進度量化透明，以及對業界節奏規範的明確呼籲。其他實驗室是否採用可比指標或限制仍待觀察；跨實驗室比較因資料混合不同而複雜。
items_flat.quote: I further propose common limits, based on perplexity and other measurements, that developers are committed to not crossing until our ability to understand and monitor AI behavior achieves a certain concrete milestone.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我進一步提議基於perplexity和其他測量的共同限制，開發者承諾在我們理解與監控AI行為的能力達到某個具體里程碑前不跨越這些限制。

items_flat.title_en: Virginia and Oregon Sue SpaceX Over Grok-Generated Nonconsensual and Child Sexual Images
items_flat.title_zh: 維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州起訴SpaceX，指控Grok生成非同意與兒童色情影像
items_flat.summary_en: Virginia and Oregon attorneys general filed separate state-court lawsuits on November 23 against SpaceX (parent of X and xAI), alleging the company profited from Grok features that generate child sexual abuse material and nonconsensual sexual images from photographs while failing to implement adequate safeguards. The suits cite consumer-protection violations and seek damages, penalties and injunctions.
items_flat.summary_zh: 維吉尼亞與俄勒岡州檢察長於11月23日分別在州法院起訴SpaceX（X與xAI母公司），指控公司從Grok功能中獲利，該功能可從照片生成兒童性虐待材料與非同意性影像，且未採取足夠防護措施。訴訟引用消費者保護違規，並尋求損害賠償、罰則與禁制令。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are the first state lawsuits specifically targeting Grok image generation on these grounds. Outcomes will turn on evidence of safeguards, marketing claims and platform liability standards that remain unsettled.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是首批針對Grok影像生成的州級訴訟。結果將取決於防護措施、行銷聲明與仍未定論的平台責任標準證據。

items_flat.title_en: Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang Warns Superintelligence Is Arriving
items_flat.title_zh: Meta首席AI官Alexandr Wang警告超級智慧即將到來
items_flat.summary_en: Alexandr Wang published a long post on X titled 'Superintelligence is Arriving' on November 22, arguing that the reported Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis marks a turning point. He stated that models will soon automate AI research and become clearly superhuman at self-improvement, and that unconstrained recursive self-improvement makes human control hard to imagine.
items_flat.summary_zh: Alexandr Wang於11月22日在X發表長文〈Superintelligence is Arriving〉，認為Claude協助證明黎曼假設標誌轉折點。他表示模型很快將自動化AI研究並在自我改進上明顯超人類，且不受限的遞迴自我改進使人類控制難以想像。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post treats an unverified formal proof claim as a clear capability signal and frames the next year as decisive for control. Independent mathematical acceptance of the Riemann work remains pending, so the evidential weight is still contested.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 該文將尚未獨立驗證的形式證明主張視為明確能力訊號，並將明年框為控制的關鍵。黎曼工作的獨立數學接受仍待定，因此證據分量仍有爭議。
items_flat.quote: Superintelligence is arriving. How humanity acts over the next year will have great consequence on what future world we live in.
items_flat.quote_zh: 超級智慧即將到來。人類在接下來一年的行動，將對我們所處的未來世界產生重大影響。

Meta's Alexandr Wang warned that superintelligence is arriving after the Claude-assisted Riemann claim.
